entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ngami chahidi be mnyezi mgu ukaya humi umbu yili nihudjuwe yirudi nihu tweyi. Ngam kubali he wakati rile nuwo he wangu wahangu no ushindzi wahaho, wo wumasikini wahangu no utadjiri wahaho. Kapvatsi mgu wasaya yitso ndawe, ye wu sayidio harumwa wo utaabifu ye wu djitosho ayece.
